review.method: Visual inspection of all 125 distinct images in five contact sheets; full-resolution checks of added positives and the bank container diagram. Family intents compared with observed content. No model fitted before review.

selection: For every training translation, the first three unjudged same-split candidates within hybrid top 10; union by family and image. No validation/test pairs reviewed or changed.
scope: train-only; labels shared across translations of the same family
policy: Grades 2=direct match, 0=explicitly different required content; ambiguous or potential partial matches remain null. Existing labels and validation/test inputs are immutable.
